item.title: Click me
item.content:encoded:
A paragraph with an evil link, a good link and a data link.

Enough ordinary words follow so that this counts as a full story rather than a summary. Feedolio keeps the HTML exactly as the feed sent it and cleans it only when a reader opens the story, so the same rules also protect saved copies of old stories. This sentence is here to push the text past four hundred characters, which is the shortest body Feedolio treats as a full story.
